description:
Direct booking link on praegant.net (optionally pre-filled with dates, party and apartment) plus the
enquiry link and contact. Does NOT book anything. check_availability already returns links per apartment.

adults.description: TOTAL adults (18+) of the whole party — also for groups larger than one apartment; the tool plans the apartments
adults.title: Adults

apartment.description: Apartment number, e.g. '12' or '#16'; empty = all apartments
apartment.title: Apartment

children.description: Ages of ALL children 0–17, comma-separated, e.g. '8,15'. Empty if none. Ages matter for price and tourist tax.
children.title: Children

language.description: 'de' (default) or 'en' — the language of the conversation
language.title: Language

name: get_booking_link
